rule.description: Watchpost: $(watchpost.type) ($(watchpost.device_name))
Watchpost: inventory item $(watchpost.type)
Watchpost: attempt to tamper with the agent ($(watchpost.data.kind)) on $(watchpost.device_name)
Watchpost: agent stopped ($(watchpost.data.reason)) on $(watchpost.device_name)
Watchpost: agent buffer full, $(watchpost.data.dropped) events purged on $(watchpost.device_name)
Watchpost: error of the agent's $(watchpost.data.collector) collector
Watchpost: agent setting changed ($(watchpost.data.key): $(watchpost.data.old) -> $(watchpost.data.new))
Watchpost: a collection or the upload was disabled in the agent ($(watchpost.data.key))
Watchpost: the agent is no longer Device Owner on $(watchpost.device_name) (local protections inactive)
Watchpost: device clock changed by $(watchpost.data.delta_ms) ms
Watchpost: USB connection with the ADB debugging function active
Watchpost: simulated position (mock location) received from provider $(watchpost.data.provider)
Watchpost: cellular security anomaly ($(watchpost.data.kind))
Watchpost: forced downgrade to 2G (possible fake base station)
Watchpost: cellular connection without encryption (null cipher)
Watchpost: disclosure of the subscriber identifier requested by the network (possible IMSI catcher)
Watchpost: Bluetooth tracker ($(watchpost.data.kind)) following the device, seen $(watchpost.data.sightings) times
Watchpost: connection to an open or weak Wi-Fi network ($(watchpost.data.ssid), $(watchpost.data.security))
Watchpost: active network without private DNS (DNS queries escape filtering)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.package) contacts a telemetry domain ($(watchpost.data.hostname))
Watchpost: app installed $(watchpost.data.package) $(watchpost.data.version_name) (installer $(watchpost.data.installer))
Watchpost: app installed outside the Play Store: $(watchpost.data.package) (installer $(watchpost.data.installer))
Watchpost: app installed without a declared installer (ADB?): $(watchpost.data.package)
Watchpost: app uninstalled $(watchpost.data.package)
Watchpost: state of the apps' special access
Watchpost: the list of accessibility services changed: $(watchpost.data.accessibility_services)
Watchpost: the list of device administrators changed: $(watchpost.data.device_admins)
Watchpost: the list of apps that read notifications changed: $(watchpost.data.notification_listeners)
Watchpost: the list of VPN apps changed: $(watchpost.data.vpn_apps)
Watchpost: sensitive permission granted to $(watchpost.data.package) ($(watchpost.data.permission))
Watchpost: SMS permission granted to $(watchpost.data.package) ($(watchpost.data.permission)): check that it is the SMS app
Watchpost: microphone used by $(watchpost.data.package)
Watchpost: camera $(watchpost.data.camera_id) used by $(watchpost.data.package)
Watchpost: microphone used by $(watchpost.data.package) while the device is locked
Watchpost: microphone used with the screen off, outside a call, by $(watchpost.data.package) (source $(watchpost.data.source))
Watchpost: camera $(watchpost.data.camera_id) used by $(watchpost.data.package) while the device is locked
Watchpost: camera $(watchpost.data.camera_id) used with the screen off by $(watchpost.data.package)
Watchpost: screen unlock failure ($(watchpost.data.failed_attempts) attempts)
Watchpost: repeated failed unlocks (5 in 10 min) on $(watchpost.device_name)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.failed_attempts) consecutive unlock failures
Watchpost: user certificate authority added ($(watchpost.data.subject))
Watchpost: user certificate authority removed ($(watchpost.data.subject))
Watchpost: Device Owner policy action failed ($(watchpost.data.action) $(watchpost.data.target))
Watchpost: security posture of $(watchpost.device_name)
Watchpost: verified boot "$(watchpost.data.verified_boot_state)" (bootloader unlocked or system modified)
Watchpost: device storage not encrypted
Watchpost: the agent is not (or no longer) Device Owner (local protections inactive)
Watchpost: private DNS disabled or not strict (mode $(watchpost.data.private_dns_mode))
Watchpost: private DNS pointed to an unexpected host ($(watchpost.data.private_dns_host))
Watchpost: wireless ADB debugging enabled
Watchpost: USB debugging (ADB) enabled
Watchpost: no secure screen lock
Watchpost: at least one user certificate authority is installed
Watchpost: security patch $(watchpost.data.patch_age_days) days old (more than 6 months)
Watchpost: installation from unknown sources allowed
Watchpost: security patch $(watchpost.data.patch_age_days) days old (more than 3 months)
Watchpost: Play Protect disabled
Watchpost: developer options enabled
Watchpost: posture changed, $(watchpost.data.field): "$(watchpost.data.old)" -> "$(watchpost.data.new)"
Watchpost: wireless ADB debugging enabled
Watchpost: USB debugging (ADB) enabled
Watchpost: developer options enabled
Watchpost: installation from unknown sources allowed
Watchpost: the agent is no longer Device Owner (local protections inactive)
Watchpost: the device storage is no longer encrypted
Watchpost: secure screen lock removed
Watchpost: Play Protect disabled
Watchpost: verified boot went from "$(watchpost.data.old)" to "$(watchpost.data.new)" (bootloader unlocked or system modified)
Watchpost: private DNS disabled or not strict (mode "$(watchpost.data.new)", before "$(watchpost.data.old)")
Watchpost: private DNS pointed to an unexpected host ("$(watchpost.data.new)")
Watchpost: user CA added (list: $(watchpost.data.new))
Watchpost: private DNS host emptied (previous: $(watchpost.data.old))
Watchpost: list of user CAs changed ("$(watchpost.data.old)" -> "$(watchpost.data.new)")
Watchpost: security patch level went from $(watchpost.data.old) to $(watchpost.data.new)
Watchpost: Android security log ($(watchpost.data.tag))
Watchpost: interactive ADB shell opened on the device
Watchpost: command run through ADB: $(watchpost.data.fields.command)
Watchpost: file transfer through ADB ($(watchpost.data.tag)): $(watchpost.data.fields.path)
Watchpost: authentication failure on the lock screen (security log)
Watchpost: repeated authentication failures on the lock screen (security log)
Watchpost: certificate authority installed (security log): $(watchpost.data.fields.subject)
Watchpost: Android security logging stopped
Watchpost: security log buffer almost full (risk of losing events)
Watchpost: integrity violation of key "$(watchpost.data.fields.alias)" (uid $(watchpost.data.fields.uid))
Watchpost: failure of the system cryptographic self-test
Watchpost: device wipe failure
Watchpost: user restriction removed ($(watchpost.data.fields.restriction)) by $(watchpost.data.fields.admin_package)
Watchpost: removable media mounted ($(watchpost.data.fields.label), $(watchpost.data.fields.mount_point))
Watchpost: certificate validation failure reported by the system ($(watchpost.data.fields.reason))
Watchpost: boot with state "$(watchpost.data.fields.verified_boot_state)" (dm-verity $(watchpost.data.fields.dm_verity_mode))
Watchpost: dm-verity not enforced at boot (mode $(watchpost.data.fields.dm_verity_mode))
Watchpost: lock screen credential changed (complexity $(watchpost.data.fields.complexity))
Watchpost: operation failed on key "$(watchpost.data.fields.alias)" ($(watchpost.data.tag))
Watchpost: remote command "$(watchpost.data.type)" issued by $(watchpost.data.created_by) to $(watchpost.device_name)
Watchpost: remote location of $(watchpost.device_name) requested by $(watchpost.data.created_by)
Watchpost: remote lock of $(watchpost.device_name) requested by $(watchpost.data.created_by) (signature to be checked by the phone; message: $(watchpost.data.message_set))
Watchpost: remote ERASE of $(watchpost.device_name) requested by $(watchpost.data.created_by) (signature to be checked by the phone)
Watchpost: removal of the lock message of $(watchpost.device_name) requested by $(watchpost.data.created_by)
Watchpost: burst of remote commands to $(watchpost.device_name) (8 in 10 min, last one: "$(watchpost.data.type)")
Watchpost: command "$(watchpost.data.type)" to $(watchpost.device_name) cancelled by $(watchpost.data.cancelled_by)
Watchpost: command "$(watchpost.data.type)" to $(watchpost.device_name) expired without a result (delivered: $(watchpost.data.delivered))
Watchpost: sensitive command "$(watchpost.data.type)" never executed by $(watchpost.device_name) (phone unreachable or command channel turned off?)
Watchpost: result received for command "$(watchpost.data.type)": $(watchpost.data.status)
Watchpost: command "$(watchpost.data.type)" processed by $(watchpost.device_name): $(watchpost.data.status)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.device_name) locked remotely (signed command executed)
Watchpost: remote ERASE of $(watchpost.device_name) executed (factory reset)
Watchpost: command "$(watchpost.data.type)" refused by $(watchpost.device_name) (reason: $(watchpost.data.detail))
Watchpost: invalid signature for the sensitive command "$(watchpost.data.type)": someone is trying to command $(watchpost.device_name) without the command passphrase
Watchpost: sensitive commands blocked for one hour on $(watchpost.device_name) after 5 invalid signatures (takeover attempt?)
Watchpost: command "$(watchpost.data.type)" already processed (sent again by the server)
Watchpost: command "$(watchpost.data.type)" failed on $(watchpost.device_name) ($(watchpost.data.detail))
Watchpost: notification from $(watchpost.data.package) ($(watchpost.data.event))
Watchpost: detection $(watchpost.type) for $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) on $(watchpost.device_name)
Watchpost: detection $(watchpost.type) (no dedicated rule, severity 3): $(watchpost.data.summary)
Watchpost: detection $(watchpost.type) (no dedicated rule, severity 2): $(watchpost.data.summary)
Watchpost: detection $(watchpost.type) updated for $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)): new item
Watchpost: detection $(watchpost.type) updated for $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)): new item
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) contacts threat domains (C2, malware, phishing): $(watchpost.data.evidence.domains)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) requested a threat domain (phishing link followed?): $(watchpost.data.evidence.domains)

Watchpost: probable SMS fraud: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) sent or tried to send SMS ($(watchpost.data.evidence.sent) sent, $(watchpost.data.evidence.rejected) refused; reason $(watchpost.data.evidence.reason))
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) uses the microphone in the background ($(watchpost.data.evidence.microphone_background) times in the day)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) uses the camera in the background ($(watchpost.data.evidence.camera_background) times in the day)
Watchpost: upload spike: $(watchpost.data.summary)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) connected to $(watchpost.data.evidence.addresses) addresses in one hour (network relay / residential proxy?)

Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) sends e-mail (ports $(watchpost.data.evidence.ports), $(watchpost.data.evidence.connections) connections) without being a known mail client
Watchpost: probable spam sending by $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)): $(watchpost.data.evidence.connections) connections to $(watchpost.data.evidence.addresses) mail servers
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) bypasses the filtering DNS through a public resolver ($(watchpost.data.evidence.providers))

Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)), installed less than 24 h ago, obtained sensitive capabilities: $(watchpost.data.evidence.capabilities) (risk $(watchpost.data.evidence.level))
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)), installed less than 24 h ago, obtained sensitive capabilities: $(watchpost.data.evidence.capabilities)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)), installed less than 24 h ago, obtained: $(watchpost.data.evidence.capabilities)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) installed with a high risk (already alerted by the risk profile)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) installed with a high risk (already alerted by the risk profile)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.type) again for $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)), already reported within 30 days
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) can send SMS without being the default SMS app (holds the SEND_SMS permission)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) became the default SMS app (before: $(watchpost.data.evidence.old)): the usual path of SMS trojans
Watchpost: default "$(watchpost.data.evidence.role)" app changed to $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) (already alerted by app.role)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) declared "system" by the device while $(watchpost.data.evidence.contradictions) say otherwise (disguise or forged inventory?)

Watchpost: limit of $(watchpost.data.evidence.limit) detections per day reached for $(watchpost.device_name) ($(watchpost.data.evidence.suppressed) dropped so far): inconsistent data or compromised device
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.type) detections muted for $(watchpost.data.package) on $(watchpost.device_name) (no longer exported or notified; reason: $(watchpost.data.reason))
Watchpost: mute lifted for the $(watchpost.data.type) detections of $(watchpost.data.package) on $(watchpost.device_name)
Watchpost: escalated detection ($(watchpost.type)) for $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)): $(watchpost.data.summary)
Watchpost: multiple suspicious behaviours of $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)) within 24 h, including $(watchpost.type): $(watchpost.data.summary)
Watchpost: risk profile of $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)): $(watchpost.data.level), score $(watchpost.data.score)
Watchpost: high risk profile for $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)), score $(watchpost.data.score): $(watchpost.data.reasons)
Watchpost: high-risk application installed: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)), score $(watchpost.data.score): $(watchpost.data.reasons)
Watchpost: application with a malware profile installed: $(watchpost.data.label) ($(watchpost.data.package)), score $(watchpost.data.score): $(watchpost.data.reasons)
Watchpost: default "$(watchpost.data.role)" application changed: $(watchpost.data.old) -> $(watchpost.data.new)
Watchpost: new default SMS application: $(watchpost.data.new) (before: $(watchpost.data.old))
Watchpost: new default phone application: $(watchpost.data.new) (before: $(watchpost.data.old))
Watchpost: new default keyboard: $(watchpost.data.new) (before: $(watchpost.data.old)); it sees everything that is typed
Watchpost: new default "$(watchpost.data.role)" application: $(watchpost.data.new) (before: $(watchpost.data.old))
Watchpost: operation $(watchpost.data.op) by $(watchpost.data.package): $(watchpost.data.count) ($(watchpost.data.background_count) in the background, $(watchpost.data.rejected_count) refused)
Watchpost: "$(watchpost.data.op)" access refused $(watchpost.data.rejected_count) times to $(watchpost.data.package)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.rejected_count) SMS sending attempts of $(watchpost.data.package) blocked (SMS guard or quarantine)
Watchpost: guard $(watchpost.data.profile): $(watchpost.data.action) $(watchpost.data.target) $(watchpost.data.permission)
Watchpost: "$(watchpost.data.target)" guard enabled on $(watchpost.device_name)
Watchpost: "$(watchpost.data.target)" guard DISABLED on $(watchpost.device_name) (protection weakened)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.target) quarantined (risky permissions refused until it is released)
Watchpost: $(watchpost.data.target) released from quarantine
Watchpost: permission $(watchpost.data.permission) restored to $(watchpost.data.target) ($(watchpost.data.profile))
Watchpost: DNS blocking level changed to "$(watchpost.data.new)" by $(watchpost.data.user) (console)
Watchpost: DNS blocking weakened: level "$(watchpost.data.old)" -> "$(watchpost.data.new)" set by $(watchpost.data.user) from the console
Watchpost: DNS blocking level "$(watchpost.data.new)" set by $(watchpost.data.user) from an unknown state (lists changed outside the console)
Watchpost: DNS rule "$(watchpost.data.action)" set on $(watchpost.data.domain) by $(watchpost.data.user) (console)
Watchpost: domain $(watchpost.data.domain) force-allowed by $(watchpost.data.user): it escapes every blocklist, threats included
Watchpost: manual block of $(watchpost.data.domain) removed by $(watchpost.data.user)
Watchpost: essential domain $(watchpost.data.domain) force-blocked by $(watchpost.data.user) (push, updates or Watchpost may stop working)
Watchpost: monitoring watcher
Watchpost: no event from $(watchpost_watch.device_name) for $(watchpost_watch.silence_min) min (device off, offline or agent stopped?)
Watchpost: $(watchpost_watch.device_name) is sending again
Watchpost: $(watchpost_watch.missing_count) events missing in the sequence of $(watchpost_watch.device_name)
Watchpost: $(watchpost_watch.missing_count) events missing (agent buffer purge)
Watchpost: sequence counter of $(watchpost_watch.device_name) went backwards (agent reinstalled or data wiped?)
Watchpost: normal rotation of a file read by Wazuh
Watchpost: critical event reported by the agent ($(watchpost.type))
Watchpost: warning reported by the agent ($(watchpost.type))
